title: Maintain an evidence-backed Devin capability inventory
what: Track full Devin functional parity rather than equating progress notifications with completion. Expand the official Cloud, API and Desktop documentation catalogs into behavioral acceptance scenarios; retain deferred Web and environment capabilities. The baseline and completion contract live in docs/devin-parity.md.

acceptance.text: Every official capability is mapped to a Touka scenario, status, owner ticket and source revision
Unknown and infrastructure-blocked capabilities remain visible instead of being marked supported
Each claimed capability has a passing executable check and appropriate live evidence
